_note: Задание для генерации. stage: images — только картинки сцен (центы); video — оживить выбранные сцены (дороже).
style: Cinematic stylized 3D animated film look (like a modern family animated movie), soft warm golden-hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, gentle realistic textures. Sunny green city park with a children's playground (wooden swings, a wooden slide tower, sand). NO other people anywhere in the frame — the park is empty except the two boys. IMPORTANT FACES: every person has a completely blank face — normal warm light-beige skin, but absolutely no facial features: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no ears details, just a smooth plain skin-colored face, calm and friendly, not scary, no shadows hiding the face. Hands are normal with the same beige skin. No text, no letters, no logos, no toys or plush animals. 16:9 wide frame.
characters: Two Muslim boys about 8 years old. AHMAD: long white qamis (ankle-length robe), white knitted kufi cap, a short navy-blue vest over the qamis, white sneakers, small brown backpack. OMAR: long sand-beige qamis, dark-green knitted kufi cap, a light olive-green jacket over the qamis, dark brown shoes. Both faces are smooth blank beige skin with no features.

Medium shot: both boys sit side by side on the edge of the wooden slide platform with legs dangling, turned toward each other talking, seen from the side. The boys are turned toward EACH OTHER (side profile or three-quarter view), never looking at the camera. Natural dynamic poses, mid-movement.

Medium side shot: the two boys shake hands warmly, both in side profile facing each other, playground behind them. The boys are turned toward EACH OTHER (side profile or three-quarter view), never looking at the camera. Natural dynamic poses, mid-movement.

video.common: The boys' faces are smooth, blank beige surfaces like faceless dolls: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no lips, no smile, the face stays completely empty and does not move. They communicate only with hand gestures and body movement. They look at each other, never at the camera. Same clothes as in the image. No other people, no animals. Natural lively body movement, stylized 3D animated film look, warm sunny light.

parameters.negativePrompt: eyes, eyebrows, mouth, lips, smile, teeth, nose, facial features, facial expression, talking mouth, face looking at camera, animals

clips.prompt: Ahmad raises his hand toward Omar in greeting; Omar lands from the swing, steps toward Ahmad and raises his hand back toward him. The empty swing keeps swaying.
The two boys stand facing each other: Omar gestures with his open hand, Ahmad nods his head and gestures back, small natural body movements, the swing sways behind them.
Ahmad puts his hand on his chest and nods, then opens his hand toward Omar; Omar nods. Slight slow camera push-in.
Omar puts his hand on his chest and nods, then lowers his hand. Slight camera drift.
Sitting on the edge of the wooden platform, the boys swing their legs and turn toward each other with lively hand gestures.
